svg.title: GODSALTER ENTERPRISES: Literal, Figurative, Mythological
svg.desc: An original text-and-symbol-first vector companion poster: a cosmic altar built from concentric celestial rings, twin moons, radiant geometry, and an atmosphere of midnight blue, amethyst, gold, and electric turquoise. By Nathan Tabor, concept November 12, 2026.
